name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: regulator notices, intolerable risks, reports waiting, late actions, audits and training

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: The same list as /attention. Regulator notices first, then risk, then everything else.
sections.sql: select item, ref, detail from v_attention order by rank, item, ref

sections.title: Regulator notices due or overdue
sections.sql: select ref, authority, kind, due_local as due, standing, rule from v_notifications where standing in ('overdue', 'due') order by due_at

sections.title: Reports in the last 14 days
sections.sql: select ref, kind, occurred_local as occurred, base, aircraft, title, reporter, class, status from v_reports where reported_at > now() - interval '14 days' order by occurred_at desc

name: hazard-register
title: Hazard register
subtitle: Every open hazard, highest risk first, with its first and latest rating and the actions against it

sections.title: Open hazards
sections.note: Risk is likelihood (1 to 5) and severity (A to E) on the ICAO matrix.
sections.sql: select ref, title, area, owner, first_risk, risk, band, open_actions, reports, last_reviewed, review_due from v_hazards where status = 'open' order by band_rank, risk, ref

name: actions
title: Corrective actions
subtitle: Open actions by due date, and finished actions waiting for someone to check they worked

sections.title: Open
sections.sql: select ref, source, description, owner, due_on, days_overdue from v_actions where status = 'open' order by due_on

sections.title: Done, not yet verified
sections.sql: select ref, source, description, owner, done_on, days_unverified from v_actions where status = 'done' order by done_on

name: assurance
title: Safety assurance
subtitle: Safety performance indicators over the last three full months, audits and training

sections.title: Safety performance indicators
sections.sql: select code, name, reports, hours, rate_per_1000, target_per_1000, alert_per_1000 from v_spis order by code

sections.title: Audits
sections.sql: select au.ref, au.title, au.scheduled_on, au.done_on, (select count(*)::int from findings f where f.audit_id = au.id) as findings from audits au order by au.scheduled_on

sections.title: Training not current
sections.sql: select name, role, base, course, expires_on, standing from v_training where standing <> 'current' order by days_left nulls first
